{{short description|American college basketball season}} {{Use American English|date=March 2026}} {{Use mdy dates|date=August 2023}} {{Infobox college sports team season |year=2020–21 |team=UNC Wilmington Seahawks |sport=Basketball |logo=UNC Wilmington Seahawks wordmark.svg |logo_size=250 |conference=Colonial Athletic Association |short_conf=CAA |CoachRank= |APRank= |record=7–10 |conf_record=1–6 |head_coach=[[Takayo Siddle]] |hc_year=1st |asst_coach1=Travis Hackert |asst_coach2=[[Kurt Kanaskie]] |asst_coach3=Monty Sanders |arena=[[Trask Coliseum]] |champion= |tourney_result= }} {{2020–21 CAA men's basketball standings}} The '''2020–21 UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of North Carolina Wilmington]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Seahawks was led by [[Takayo Siddle]], who took over from [[C.B. McGrath]] when he was fired by UNCW in January 2020.{{cite news |last1=Giglio |first1=Joe |title=UNCW basketball set to hire Takayo Siddle as next coach |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/college/acc/nc-state/article241172106.html |accessdate=August 18, 2020 |work=[[The News & Observer]] |date=March 13, 2020}} They played their home games at [[Trask Coliseum]] as part of the [[Colonial Athletic Association]]. ==Previous season== The Seahawks finished the [[2019–20 UNC Wilmington Seahawks men's basketball team|2019–20]] season with a 10–22 record and 5–13 in conference play. They were eliminated in the first round of the [[2020 CAA men's basketball tournament]] when they lost to the [[2019–20 Drexel Dragons men's basketball team|Drexel Dragons]]. ==Offseason== ===Departures=== {| class="wikitable sortable" border="1" !
